source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council on the post-1923 county electoral divisions; nominations closed 30 April 1924, polled 29 May 1924. No candidates were nominated for the Crossmaglen, Forkhill and Killeavy divisions (Frontier Sentinel, 10 May 1924, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
